scope: Original user-uploaded OECD EXGRVA CSV ZIP versus previously retained historical Parquet, all complete records
method: Read all ZIP CSV rows and all historical Parquet rows; serialize ten nonnumeric dimension columns in CSV header order as UTF-8 separated by byte 0x1f, append OBS_VALUE parsed and packed as little-endian IEEE-754 binary64, calculate SHA-256 per record, and compare sorted complete multisets (multiplicity included). Parquet decoded from Thrift metadata with system ZSTD library.
notes: ZIP data were streamed to EOF with CRC32 verified; the test is invariant to row order.
A 256-bit hash collision is theoretically possible but cryptographically negligible; this is a full-record hash-multiset comparison, not a literal relational join.
The test establishes equality of the exact two supplied files, not independent validation of the original OECD category selection or official upstream release provenance.
Neither raw CSV nor Parquet is published in this repository.
